body: Clash B. His doc: 'Because the Framework is part of your mind, the Octave also describes the Framework.' Concern raised: if the Octave describes the Framework and the Framework checks the Octave, the check runs from inside (what parallel lenses exist to prevent). Read back as the option 'Describes the runner: the Octave maps you, the person running the Framework, not the Framework itself. The check stays outside.' JayArr chose it, 2026-10-11. The 10-07 Octave purpose statement stands unwidened. Consequence: an AuDHD finding about how he processes updates the Octave; it updates the Framework only where it names a change to the cycle or a tool, and then as a separate ruling.
plain: The Octave maps the person running the Framework, not the Framework itself. The check on Octave claims stays outside.
